DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 近々レッドウィンターに来るって聞いたんだけど、本当？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、そのつもり

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何か用事とか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ううん、これといって何かあるわけじゃないんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 久しぶりに会えそうだなって思って

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時間があったら、227号にも寄ってもらえると嬉しい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生も知ってると思うけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うちの学園、敷地が広過ぎるよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それはまあ、確かに

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: その上寒いし、凶暴な野生動物も多いし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だから、来る時は呼んでね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ガイド無しで歩いてたら

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 危険な目に遭うかもしれないし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃ、そういうことで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、ちゃんと帰れた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まさか、寄り道なんてしてないよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: おかげで無事

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今日はゆっくり休ませてもらいます

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、それなら良かった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっきも話したけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: レッドウィンターに来る時は、ちゃんと連絡してね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text:
安全第一なんだから。
分かった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、さっき聞いたんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もしかして、私のこと探してた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、後で時間貰える？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: この間のお礼をしたくて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: へえ、楽しみにしてるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そんなに気にしなくていいのに、ふふ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあ、構わないけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 了解

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、また後で

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: よろしくね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、無事に帰れた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあ、今日は先生が迷うような場所じゃなかったけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、ちゃんと帰れたよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: シグレこそ、大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、おかげさまで

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日は本当にありがとね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次は私がお礼をする番かな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: こうやってお礼が重なり続けるのも、何だか悪くないかなって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: だから、その時はよろしくね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それじゃ、良い一日を

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 良かったら、後でちょっと時間貰える？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先日のお礼も兼ねて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 料理を作ってあげようかなって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 料理？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: シャーレまで来てくれるの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん、そう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 材料は持っていくから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 期待してもらって良いよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあ、後で日程を決めよっか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういえば、お礼を言いそびれてた気がして

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ごめん、遅くなっちゃった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ありがとう、すごく美味しかった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それで、さっき思いついたんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっきのウォッカだけどさ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 下味をつける時に使えば良いんじゃ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 料理には清酒でね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ウォッカはダメだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ふふっ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生はやっぱり面白いなぁ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 了解、じゃあそうする

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それじゃまたね、先生

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 듣자 하니 조만간 우리 학교로 올 일이 있다던데, 사실이야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 뭐, 딱히 이유가 있어서 그러는 건 아니고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 간만에 얼굴 좀 볼 수 있을까 하고 기대하는 거지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님도 붉은겨울 학원에 올 때마다 느끼겠지만

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 우리 학원은 부지가 너무 과하게 넓은 것 같아

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 게다가 기온도 낮고 흉포한 야생 동물도 많은 편이라

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러니 올 일이 있으면 꼭 날 불러줘

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 가이드 없이 붉은겨울 학원을 혼자 돌아다니면

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 위험한 일을 당할 수도 있으니까 말이야

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 또 딴 길로 샜다거나 그러지는 않았겠지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 걱정하지 마. 오늘은 이제 쉴 거야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 좋아. 그 말을 들으니 안심이 되네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 붉은겨울 학원에 올 일이 있으면 꼭 연락해야 해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님이 나를 찾았다는 이야기를 들어서 말이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 응. 혹시 나중에 시간 좀 괜찮아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 전에 받은 도움의 답례를 하고 싶어서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 보기보다 단도직입적인걸. 또 이렇게 의외의 면모를 보게 되네

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘은 선생님도 길 헤맬 곳이 아니라서 마음이 좀 놓이네

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이렇게 계속 답례와 대접을 주고받는 것도 썩 나쁘지 않은 것 같아

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 좋아. 다음엔 내 차례라고 알고 있을게

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 혹시 괜찮다면, 나중에 시간 좀 내줄 수 있을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이번에는 내가 선생님한테 요리를 대접해 주고 싶은데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮은 날을 정해주면 재료를 들고 찾아갈게

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 감사 인사를 전했어야 했는데 깜빡했네, 미안.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님이 만들어 준 요리, 굉장히 맛있었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 밑간을 할 때 보드카를 썼으면 더 좋지 않았을까?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's rumors you'll be visiting us soon. Is that true?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Yup. The rumors are true.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Why were you wondering?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Not for any particular reason, I guess.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Just wondering...if I'll get to see you while you're here.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You should stop by Spec Ops... If you have time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I mean, I'm sure you think of us every time you come visit anyway, right? Heehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I think our school takes up way more space than we need.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's pretty big, I'd agree.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: On top of that, there's wild bears everywhere, and it's always cold.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyways, let me know when you get here.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you try to go around campus without a guide,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: you could get yourself into some real trouble.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: All right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Did you get back okay, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You didn't get distracted or anything, did you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm back home now, thanks to you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm going to get some rest now, so don't worry.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay, okay. If you say so.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But like I said,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: you've got to tell me when you're coming to Red Winter Academy.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Promise?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You need something, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I heard you were looking for me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I was. Do you have some free time?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I wanted to repay you for helping me last time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I didn't expect you to be so...forward, I guess.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sure, why not?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll look forward to it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: See you soon, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Did you get home okay, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I wasn't too worried, this time at least. Even you can't lose the path on a day like today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm safe and sound. What about you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Did you get home safely?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes, thanks to you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Seriously, thanks. The food was really good too.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Next time, let me treat you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: That kind of give-and-take'd be nice, you know?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Good? The next one's on me.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay, have a good one, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: No pressure to say yes, but do you have some time today?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I still need to get you back for the last time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So, let me make food for you today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You want to cook for me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: At Schale?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yup, you've got it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll come over with some ingredients, just let me know when you're free.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've got something awesome planned.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you soon, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I forgot to say thank you...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Your cooking was really good.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But I just thought of something...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Umm...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I was thinking that the dish could've used a little vodka. To add to the taste.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You use rice wine for cooking, not vodka.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Vodka isn't allowed for students or cooking!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Heehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Maybe I just like hearing you nag me, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Okay.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see ya, Sensei.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ได้ยินว่าเดี๋ยวคุณครูจะมาทำธุระ
ที่โรงเรียนเรางั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อ๋อ ใช่แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม.. ไม่ได้มีเหตุผลอะไรเป็นพิเศษหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็แค่อยากเห็นหน้าหน่อยน่ะ ไม่ได้เจอ
กันมาสักพักแล้วนี่เนอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮิฮิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้ามีเวลาก็แวะมาห้องเรียนพิเศษบ้างนะ~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครูก็น่าจะรู้สึกเหมือนกัน
ในทุกครั้งที่มาสหภาพเรดวินเทอร์

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ว่าโรงเรียนของเรามันกว้างขวางเกินไป

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: กว้างมากๆ เลยละ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แถมอากาศหนาวแล้วก็มี
สัตว์ป่าดุร้ายมากมาย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เพราะงั้นเวลามาที่นี่ก็บอกฉันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้ามาเดินเตร็ดเตร่ในสหภาพเรดวินเทอร์
โดยไม่มีใครนำทางละก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูอาจเจอเรื่องอันตรายได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เข้าใจมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ถึงที่พักแล้วหรือยัง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ได้แอบไปที่อื่นอีกใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม ครูมาถึงแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ต้องห่วงหรอก
ครูว่าจะไปพักผ่อนแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ดีมาก ได้ฟังแบบนี้ก็โล่งใจ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถึงฉันจะบอกไปแล้วก็เถอะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ถ้ามีธุระต้องมาที่สหภาพเรดวินเทอร์
ต้องติดต่อฉันด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เข้าใจมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู เรียกฉันเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ได้ยินมาว่าคุณครูเรียกหาฉันน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม พอมีเวลาว่างบ้างมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ครูอยากตอบแทนที่ชิกุเระ
ช่วยครูไว้ก่อนหน้านี้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เป็นคนตรงไปตรงมามากกว่าที่เห็นแฮะ
ได้เห็นด้านที่คาดไม่ถึงอีกแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ปฏิเสธคงไม่ดีสินะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นก็รบกวนด้วยแล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้เจอกันนะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ถึงที่พักแล้วยังน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้ฉันค่อนข้างเบาใจ เพราะคุณครูคง
ไม่ไปเดินเตร็ดเตร่ที่ไหน

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูกลับมาถึงแล้ว ชิกุเระล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ชิกุเระก็ถึงที่พักแล้วใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม มาถึงอย่างปลอดภัยเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ได้กินอาหารอร่อยๆ เยอะเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
งั้นต่อไปก็ต้องเป็นตาของฉันแล้วหรือ
เปล่านะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ได้ผลัดกันตอบแทนไปเรื่อยๆ แบบนี้
ก็ไม่เลวเหมือนกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ดีละ งั้นครั้งหน้าฉันขอเป็นเจ้ามือแล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮิฮิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นก็ไปพักผ่อนเถอะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าไม่ได้ติดธุระอะไร ขอเวลาให้ฉัน
หน่อยได้มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันอยากตอบแทนเรื่องคราวที่แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ครั้งนี้ฉันอยากลองทำอาหาร
ให้คุณครูชิมน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ชิกุเระจะทำอาหารให้ครูเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จะมาที่ชาเล่ต์เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม ใช่แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคุณครูบอกวันที่สะดวกมา
ฉันจะเตรียมวัตถุดิบไปเอง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบอกว่าตั้งตารอได้เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้เจอกันนะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ้อ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันต้องขอบคุณคุณครูด้วย แต่ดันลืม
ไปซะได้ ขอโทษนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อาหารที่คุณครูทำให้อร่อยมากๆ เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พอดีเพิ่งจะมานึกได้น่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ตอนปรุงรส ถ้าใช้วอดก้าก็น่าจะ
อร่อยกว่านั้นนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าอยากใส่แอลกอฮอล์
ก็ใช้ไวน์ข้าวแทนเอานะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
วอดก้าเป็นของต้องห้าม
ในการทำอาหารนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฮิฮิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คำบ่นของคุณครูเนี่ย ฟังทีไรก็สนุกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็ได้ๆ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นไว้เจอกันใหม่นะคุณครู

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 聽說你最近會到赤冬來，是真的嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 也沒有，雖然沒什麼特別的事

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只是覺得似乎能久違地見到老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果有空能來227號這邊一趟我會很開心的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我們學園的領地實在太大了對吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 而且氣溫又低，還有很多凶暴的野生動物

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以，過來的時候和我說一聲吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果沒有嚮導陪同的話

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 該不會還繞到其他地方去了吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 今天就讓我好好休息吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 來赤冬的時候，請先聯絡我哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text:
安全第一。
知道了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我想答謝你之前的幫忙

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實不用那麼客氣的，呵呵

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然今天老師不是在會迷路的地方就是了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次就輪到我回禮了呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 像這樣不斷禮尚往來好像也不錯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼，祝你有美好的一天

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 方便的話，之後可以耽誤你一點時間嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這麼說來，我好像忘記向你道謝了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 在事先調味的時候用不就好了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 料理的時候要用清酒哦
